rationale: Parent (round-3 kept state: GPT-6 Luna + PDF + reasoning_effort='none') is at the Pareto frontier on all 3 objectives (accuracy=0.9807, latency=12112ms, cost=$0.002324/row). Gate math from this parent requires improving ≥1 axis past its epsilon (acc>0.9857 OR latency<11112ms OR cost<$0.002024) with no axis regressing past its epsilon (acc≥0.9757, latency≤13112, cost≤$0.002624). Every reachable mutation fails this math: (a) input_mode=text (round 4, verified) saves 3.6s latency and $0.0006/row but regresses accuracy by 0.027 (5× the 0.005 epsilon) — card-art fields (cardAvailableCreditLimit 0.776→0.245, cardDisplayName 0.918→0.490) are text-blind; (b) hybrid routing by filename co-brand (text only for the ~10% of rows where text won in round 4: expressions, rubyx) moves median latency negligibly (median still sits in PDF distribution), saves only ~$0.00006/row (<< $0.0003), and nudges accuracy ~+0.002 (< 0.005) — no axis clears its epsilon; (c) GPT-5.6 Luna at reasoning='none'+PDF is 2–2.4× per-token so predicted cost ≥$0.0027 (regresses $0.0003 epsilon); (d) GLM/DeepSeek are text-only and inherit the −0.027 accuracy regression; (e) max_tokens cap with reasoning='none' has no output-token slice to cut and risks truncation failures; (f) raising reasoning back to low/medium to chase accuracy regresses latency by 2.9s/5.7s (already explored rounds 1→2→3). The reasoning-ladder monotone (medium→low→none) across three kept rounds has captured the entire reasoning-token axis. The remaining accuracy ceiling (field_cards_cardMeta_network=0.0, cardCreditLimit=0.776) is structural (enum mismatches and card-art parsing limits that medium CoT in rounds 1–2 also could not fix) — not reachable by the available levers. Noop preserves the frontier.
